messages:
lina: Heads up: EdgeScale partner onboarding — they report device-hours and per-instance credits. Need mapping to our marketplace credit units + entitlement join. Can we triage? cc @maya_pm @samir @jon_enginfra

maya_pm: On it. Do we have a sample payload? Need event_id, timestamp (UTC preferred), device_id, meter_id, and quantity. Also confirm their timezone behavior.

samir: If they send device-hours, we need a conversion to our internal 'compute-credit' units. Who owns conversion factor and rounding policy? Also clarify billing window (UTC daily end-of-day?)

lina: I asked EdgeScale and they sent this sample last night:

```json
{"event_id":"es-evt-20260320-0001","device_id":"edge-42","meter_id":"inst_hours","timestamp":"2026-03-19T22:00:00-05:00","quantity":4.5}
```

jon_enginfra: We'll require an idempotency key. Suggest dedupe key = event_id + device_id + date(window_start). Also ingest should normalize timestamps to UTC on arrival. We currently accept late arrivals up to 7 days for marketplace feeds.

alex_recon: For reconciliation: nightly job will compare partner-reported totals vs our ingested totals. Example SQL for the job:

```
SELECT partner_id, DATE(timestamp_utc) AS usage_date, SUM(credits) AS reported_credits
FROM partner_usage_ingest
WHERE partner_id = 'edgescale'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```

Set tolerance at 0.5% or $100, whichever is greater, then trigger alert.

priya_legal: Contract note: EdgeScale agreed to per-instance billing with a 1% rounding tolerance and a 60-day dispute window. We need to surface that in the integration doc and in any reconciliation alerts.

maya_pm: Proposed onboarding checklist:
- schema signoff (include timezone and id fields)
- test batch (10k events across 3 regions)
- validation run with reconciliation script
- parity check + SLA smoke tests
- enable production feed

lina: Owners: maya_pm -> schema & tests; samir -> conversion logic & pricing mapping; jon_enginfra -> ingestion + idempotency + TTL; alex_recon -> daily reconciliation dashboard; priya_legal -> contract edgecases.

samir: Quick question: rounding direction? floor, ceil, or round-to-nearest? Prefer round-to-nearest to avoid systematic underbilling.

priya_legal: Contract language says 'round to nearest cent' for monetary amounts but doesn't call out unit rounding. I'll confirm with legal and update by EOD.

partners-bot: New task created: "edgescale-integration-checklist" assigned to maya_pm, due 2026-03-24.

alex_recon: One more gotcha: EdgeScale's sample used local timestamps (America/Chicago). We must insist on either UTC or an explicit offset. Otherwise daily aggregation windows will misalign.

lina: Agreed. maya_pm, please add timezone requirement to the schema and make ingestion fail fast for events without tz info or offset.

maya_pm: Will do. Also adding a small staging endpoint they can POST to: POST /partner-edge-scale/v1/ingest (staging) with schema validation response. We'll return 422 for schema violations.

jon_enginfra: Ingress rate note: they expect up to 50k events/hour. We'll autoscale but set a soft throttle at 20 rps initially. Samir, what's the preferred backpressure policy? 429 or queueing?

samir: Prefer graceful queueing for 30s with a retry window, fallback to 429 when queue full. Expose metrics: ingest_rate, dedupe_rate, late_arrival_count.

lina: Thanks. I'll capture this in the partner playbook. @alex_recon please spin up the initial dashboard and link it here once ready.

alex_recon: Done: dashboard link https://console.redwood/apps/dashboards/edgescale-recon — will ACL for partner view and internal oncall. :white_check_mark:

lina: Great work team — I'll draft the integration doc and ping for a quick review tomorrow morning.
